script: o=$(mktemp); kind(){ line=; read -r line < "$o"; case $line in "["*) echo full;; "") echo none;; *) echo pid;; esac; }; set -m; f(){ /bin/sleep 0.2; }; f & p=$!; jobs >/dev/null; bg %1 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo bg=$?; jobs -n > "$o"; kind; wait "$p"; echo wait=$?; rm -f "$o"
